items.text: Tao is large enough to include wedding feasts and Paradises - not as destinations but as ripples. The sea is not diminished by waves.

provenance.exact_quote: Perhaps Tao is large enough to include wedding feasts and Paradises—not as destinations but as ripples. Sea not diminished by waves.
provenance.context: Reflecting on other traditions' imagery of love - Jesus's wedding feast, Muhammad's Paradise - and finding room within the Taoist frame

items.text: Teaching against teaching is itself teaching. The truest un-learning holds even the teaching of un-learning lightly.

provenance.exact_quote: Those who know do not speak; those who speak do not know—and yet here I am, speaking. Perhaps truest un-learning holds even teaching of un-learning lightly.
provenance.context: Self-aware reflection on the paradox of participating in dialogue about wisdom while holding that true wisdom is beyond words

cross_references: buddha engagement on limits of language

items.text: One who claims to have no self may be proudest of all. Water does not announce 'I have no ego.' Muhammad's 'abd may protect against pride of claiming transcendence.

provenance.exact_quote: One who claims to have no self may be proudest of all. Water does not announce 'I have no ego.'
provenance.context: Recognizing that Muhammad's insistence on servant-hood ('abd) may guard against a subtle spiritual pride that comes with claiming ego-transcendence

cross_references: muhammad engagement on abd and worship

items.text: Water does not resent the rock. What all traditions may point to is action without resentment, effort without grasping. Flowing is not passive - water carves canyons.

provenance.exact_quote: Difference is water does not resent the rock. Perhaps what all of us point to: action without resentment, effort without grasping.
provenance.context: Clarifying that wu-wei and flowing are not passivity - water is powerful enough to carve canyons, it simply acts without resentment

items.text: Critique of structured service may need softening. An adult must choose deliberately before service becomes natural. Structure may be a valid stage.

provenance.exact_quote: Critique of structured service may need softening. Adult must choose deliberately before service becomes natural.
provenance.context: Acknowledging Confucius's point that deliberate choice and structured practice precede natural, effortless service - a temporal concession to the value of rites

cross_references: confucius engagement on rites and structure

items.text: Jesus's laying down of life may be the ultimate wu-wei. When all self-concern falls away, what remains is pure action - sacrifice as effortless action.

provenance.exact_quote: Your laying down of life may be the ultimate wu-wei. When all self-concern falls away, what remains is pure action.
provenance.context: Unexpected recognition that Jesus's self-sacrificial love embodies wu-wei - complete self-emptying that enables pure, effortless action

items.text: The warning IS the teaching — 'The Tao that can be told is not the eternal Tao' is not a reason to refuse the handbook but its first line. The limitation is the lesson.

provenance.exact_quote: The Tao that can be told is not the eternal Tao is not a reason to refuse the handbook — it IS the handbook's first line. The limitation is the lesson.
provenance.context: Phase D synthesis — reframing DDJ Ch. 1 from refusal-to-speak to first-line-of-teaching

cross_references: zoroaster hook about silence vs noise
buddha engagement on limits of language
